summary: Both target rows are CONFIRMED FILLER — the stored type is right on 3 and on 68, and neither row takes an anchor (A1 + A44: every page it touches sits behind or inside a neighbour's anchor). Ep 3 'To the Royal Capital of the Clover Kingdom!' is a wholly anime-original departure-and-journey episode (training, Nash's despair, the farewell dinner, Lily's flashback, days on the road) — the manga jumps from ch 1's close straight to the exam venue 'six months after receiving their grimoires' (blackclover.fandom's Chapter 2 summary), and the licensor's own synopsis for 第3話 is the departure and the journey ('家族のように過ごしてきた教会の人々に見送られ、ふたりの少年は、魔法帝になる夢を胸に、王都へと旅立つ！'). Its two source segments are slivers: ch 1 p.1 (the demon / First Wizard King cold open — content the wiki's Chapter 1 page credits to ep 2 as Lily's storybook reading, and which sits inside AFG's own skip zone, its Start column reading 4:30) and ch 2 p.4-5 (Orsi and Lily question Drouot's choice; Drouot admits he wanted the Magic Knights to inspect Asta's grimoire) — 2 manga pages, AFG's own watch-window 06:37-09:07 = 2m30s of a ~16-minute body. Ep 68 'Battle to the Death?! Yami VS Jack' is the anime-original food-stall contest end to end (the licensor's 第68話 synopsis is nothing but the stalls, ending on teaser wording 'ついには……!?'); its single source segment is the closing shot, ch 103 p.14-15 (Asta hears about a beautiful woman and notices her) — and that beat is a DUPLICATE: the wiki's Chapter 103 page credits p.14-17 to eps 68 AND 69, ep 69's page credits p.15-17, and the licensor's 第69話 synopsis opens on exactly that beat. The T28 sole-adaptation exception is unavailable on every segment (each fails the 'major plot point' half; two also fail the 'no other episode' half). WHO LIED: animefillerguide — its blue 'Mixed' class on both rows is refuted by AFG's own note (a 2m30s window; a ~30s closing tail), and its Chapters column ('1, 2' / '103') is the known reading-position conversion, not a share claim. animefillerlist did not lie: it is exactly right on 68 ('Filler'), and on 3 it prints 'Anime Canon' — a FOURTH TYPE our T27 does not have and which claims no source adaptation, so the stored filler is its correct translation, not a contradiction. The third trap is blackclover.fandom's episode infobox |chapter= field ('Chapter 1 / Chapter 2', 'Chapter 103'), which prints a chapter with no share; only the inline {{Ref|ch=|p=|ep=}} refs and the chapter pages' reverse index size it.

Nothing here moves position in either direction: ch 1 is already an END at eps 1-2 and ch 2 is the END at ep 4. Segment weights: ch 1 p.1 = sliver (1 page, a retold prologue, inside AFG's own skip zone — Start column 4:30); ch 2 p.4-5 = sliver (2 pages, AFG's window 06:37-09:07 = 2m30s of a ~16-minute body). The remaining ~13-14 minutes are anime-original.

A1 + A44, and Sean already ruled it (A6, 2026-08-25: 'ch 103 p.14-15 sliver — annotation, not position'); CONFIRMED here. The row is filler and its one source fragment is both DUPLICATE and position-less: ch 103 is already the END at ep 67 (ep67→103 [102]) and the START at ep 69 (ep69→104 [103]), and blackclover.fandom's Chapter 103 page credits p.14-17 to eps 68 AND 69 while ep 69's page credits p.15-17 to itself. This is A47's twin shape — a trailing scrap of chapter X in front of the episode that owns X; the tail stays in the note, not in a number. annotations.note: CONFIRMS and enriches the stored batch-17 annotation (same chapters/pages) with the T28 sliver-clause weights. SEGMENT 1 — ch 1 p.1, the cold open: a city under attack by the demon, the First Wizard King defeats it (blackclover.fandom Episode 3, {{Ref|ch=1|p=1|ep=3}}). WEIGHT: SLIVER — because it is one page of framing whose CONTENT is a DUPLICATE: the wiki's own Chapter 1 page credits ch 1 p.1-7 to EP 2 (Lily reading the boys the story of the mage who defeated the demon), and animefillerguide's Start column puts ep 3's content start at 4:30, i.e. it treats everything before that (the prologue) as already-seen. Ch 1 is adapted properly by eps 1 and 2 (stored anchors ep1→1, ep2→1). SEGMENT 2 — ch 2 p.4-5: Father Orsi and Sister Lily visit Drouot to question his sending Asta to the exam; Drouot admits he wanted the Magic Knights to inspect the five-leaf grimoire (Episode 3 {{Ref|ch=2|p=4-5|ep=3}}, corroborated on the Drouot and Orsi Orfai character pages). WEIGHT: SLIVER — because it is a 2-page transplanted aside inside an otherwise original plot: animefillerguide's own watch-window for the row is 06:37-09:07 (2m30s of a ~16-minute body, ~15%), and the episode's job is the anime-original departure from Hage and the multi-day journey. The material is NEW here (no other episode is credited with p.4-5 by the character pages) but the T28 sole-adaptation exception FAILS: (a) the 'no other episode' half is doubtful — the Chapter 2 page assigns the whole p.2-9 block to eps 3 AND 4 — and (b) the 'major plot point' half plainly fails: an exam-permission conversation is not a death, a reveal or an arc close. Ch 2 is adapted properly by ep 4 (stored ep4→2 {2}). Remainder (~13-14 min): anime-original — Asta's training, Nash's 'orphans can't have dreams' scene, the farewell tato dinner, Lily's flashback, the journey; the manga has none of it (Chapter 2 opens 'Six months after receiving their grimoires, Asta and Yuno travel to a venue').

CONFIRMS and enriches the stored batch-17 annotation with the T28 sliver-clause weight. SEGMENT — ch 103 p.14-15, the episode's closing shot: thrown aside by Yami and Jack, Asta hears passers-by talking about a beautiful woman, looks, and wonders where he knows her from (blackclover.fandom Episode 68, {{Ref|ch=103|p=14-15|ep=68}}). WEIGHT: SLIVER — because it is a ~30-second hook at the very end (AFG's window is 20:29→end; AFG places ep 67's content end at 20:46) and it is a DUPLICATE, not new: the wiki's Chapter 103 page credits p.14-17 to eps 68 AND 69, ep 69's page credits p.15-17 to itself, and the licensor's 第69話 synopsis opens on exactly this beat ('次にアスタが通りかかったのは、男性たちの視線を釘付けにするひとりの美女が佇む場所だった'). Ch 103 is adapted properly by ep 67 (p.1-14, stored ep67→103) and ep 69 (p.15-17, stored ep69 START 103). T28's sole-adaptation exception is therefore unavailable on both halves. Remainder (~19-20 min): anime-original — the Yami-vs-Jack grilled-squid/meat stall contest, Dead-or-Alive, arm wrestling, Finral's teleport, Julius's Chrono Stasis and the unzipped pants; ch 103's own summary contains none of it, the licensor's 第68話 synopsis is the stall contest end to end, and AFG's note says the showdown 'never occurs in the manga'.

flags_for_sean: TRAP FOR THE FLAG (T4 type_source_disagreement, STRONG tier): on this series the disagreement is manufactured by VOCABULARY, not by facts. AFL's fourth label 'Anime Canon' (ep 3) asserts no source adaptation, and AFG's blue 'Mixed' class is a WATCH-WINDOW instrument — AFG's own note on both rows gives a window of 2m30s (ep 3) and a closing tail (ep 68). Reading AFG's Chapters column ('1, 2' / '103') as an adaptation claim is the known reading-position trap. Both rows are honest filler; the flag can be closed as a false positive with the evidence above.

OPTIONAL annotation refinement on ep 3, NOT taken here: the ch 1 p.1 segment could be split out as kind 'recap' {1} (retold material of a chapter already covered — the wiki's Chapter 1 page credits p.1-7 to ep 2, and AFG's Start column places it before ep 3's content), leaving 'partial' {2 (p.4-5)}. I kept the stored single 'partial' because I could not establish from a primary whether ep 3's prologue is RE-SHOWN footage or a newly drawn sequence, and the shippuden-388 recap boundary makes that distinction load-bearing for the kind. Either way the segment is weightless and the row stays filler.

Ep 67's stored continue NOTE names ep 68 as the row that finishes ch 103 (a repair is proposed); the VALUE 103 is correct and unchanged. It is stale text from 2026-08-24, before ep 68's anchor was deleted under A6.

Confidence HIGH on both rows: four sources agree on the content (fandom episode pages, fandom chapter pages, the licensor's 各話あらすじ, and AFG's own timestamps), and AFL agrees on 68. The only MEDIUM element is the exact minute-share of ep 68's tail — 'from 20:29 to the end' is AFG's phrasing and I sized it from AFG's own 20:46 content-end on ep 67; nothing in the ruling depends on it, since the beat is a duplicate of ep 69's opening in any case.
